title: Blend Lean replayed on Pinnacle's early prices
note: Blend Lean replayed on Pinnacle's early prices from football-data, not on DraftKings: each league's blend refitted every 28 days on earlier matches only, sigma from each fit's own matches, $1 a bet on the side at least 1 sigma above the early price's break-even, CLV against Pinnacle's margin-free close. Pinnacle is a sharper price than DraftKings, so this is a tougher test than the live one, and it isn't the live book: a blend fitted on Pinnacle and fed Pinnacle's own prices doesn't have the mismatch live Lean has (fitted on Pinnacle, fed DraftKings' price, with b above 1 sharpening it). The Champions League has no early prices: it is replayed at DraftKings' close and kept out of the pooled numbers.

rule.blend_fit: Pinnacle's margin-free close beside the model's walk-forward chance
rule.clv: entry odds x Pinnacle's margin-free (Shin) close - 1
rule.cup: Champions League at DraftKings' bought close (cup_backtest.py), CLV against Pinnacle's close at the same moment; kept out of `all`
rule.driver: market = still at least 1 sigma with the model's term taken out of the fitted blend (c = 0, a and b kept as fitted, no refit); model = only with it
rule.driver_note: Market-driven: the pick still clears 1 sigma when the model's term is taken out of the fitted blend (the blend's other weights are kept as fitted, not refitted). Model-driven: it clears 1 sigma only with the model's term in. The model's term compares the model's chances across home, draw and away, not against the price, so where the model's weight is positive it lifts the outcome the model rates highest relative to the others, even when the model rates that outcome below the market.

bands.edge_from: p_bet x odds - 1 (the blend's edge); z beside it
bands.note: Every bet, split by its decimal odds (lo < odds <= hi), by the edge the strategy claimed when it bet, and by its CLV; the edge and CLV bands are cut at the pooled domestic leagues' quintiles, the same cuts in every league. ROI and CLV are per $1 with 95% ranges from resampling matches. If the model had skill, CLV would rise with the claimed edge.

calibration.note: Every outcome (home, draw, away) of every scored match, not only the bets: the model's raw walk-forward chance, the blend and the price (margin-free), each against what happened; `bets` is the strategy's own picks (predicted vs 1/odds vs won). Each bin holds the rows whose predicted chance falls in it: predicted is their average chance, implied the price's, realized how often they won (95% range). On a well-calibrated model realized sits on predicted. The slope is from logit(won) = a + b x logit(predicted): below 1 the chances are too spread out (over-confident).

flat.note: Tracked alternative only: the same trades with a different stake, no new bets; flat $10 stays the record. Paper bankroll $1,000 at the first trade; quarter Kelly (0.25 x f*, f* = (p x odds - 1) / (odds - 1)), at most 5% of the bankroll a bet, nothing when f* <= 0. Each stake uses only the bankroll from bets settled before it opened; pushes and voids return the stake. Kelly assumes p is right: every strategy's CLV is below 0, so the edge it sizes on is not proven.

kelly.p_note: p = the blend's chance (p_bet for Lean; the blend's chance for Model 12%'s side).

UCL.name: Champions League
UCL.note: Champions League, priced at the close, not early: the only cup prices we hold are the closes bought for 2024/25 and 2025/26 (Pinnacle and DraftKings, one snapshot a kickoff slot). Bets are taken at DraftKings' close on the cross-league model's walk-forward chances; CLV compares that price with Pinnacle's margin-free close at the same moment, so it shows how far DraftKings sits from Pinnacle, not price movement. Clubs the model doesn't cover and low-data matches are skipped, as in the live paper test. Blend Lean: the blend needs 300 earlier matches before its first fit (302 in all), so only 1 of the 295 candidate matches come after a fit, giving 0 bets: far too few to judge.
UCL.price: DraftKings' close (bought, The Odds API), break-even = 1/decimal
UCL.clv: entry odds x Pinnacle's margin-free (Shin) close - 1

draftkings_replay.label: DraftKings replay, Premier League (seasons 2025)
draftkings_replay.note: The same Lean rule on DraftKings' own historical prices (Premier League only; the DraftKings backtest's walk-forward blend and sigma). Few matches qualify.
